room.name: Every Dash Turns the Cliff
room.hint: Wave onto blue and carry the restored dash through the phase wall. Spend it from the ring to bring gold back. Leave the rising decks before their thorn ceilings. Hold grab to swing and jump through seed cuts.

bank.author: Claude; revised by Sol 6.1
bank.role: Thunder Cliffs Core: swing, ride and climb while every dash turns the cliff
bank.solution: Wave onto blue with the dash restored, pass the absent gold wall and spend the dash from the ring. Leave both rising decks before the thorn ceilings; carry momentum west and brake onto the return ledge.
bank.coreDescription: The storm turns the cliff each time you dash. Count before you let go.
